intro.en: A student goes to a bookshop and buys a dictionary, books, a notebook and a pen. Learn how to say what you want politely: أُريدُ (urīdu – I want) and تَفَضَّلْ (tafaḍḍal – here you are).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke ek talib-e-ilm kitaabon ki dukaan par jaakar lughat, kitaabein, copy aur qalam kaise khareedta hai. Hum seekhenge ke apni cheez adab se kaise maangte hain: أُريدُ (urīdu – main chahta hoon) aur تَفَضَّلْ (tafaḍḍal – ye lijiye).
intro.ar: يَذْهَبُ طالِبٌ إِلى المَكْتَبَةِ وَيَشْتَري مُعْجَماً وَكُتُباً وَدَفْتَراً وَقَلَماً. نَتَعَلَّمُ الطَّلَبَ بِأَدَب: «أُريدُ» وَ«تَفَضَّلْ».

dialogue.en: Welcome.
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed.

dialogue.en: I want a dictionary, please.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe ek lughat chahiye, meherbani karke.

dialogue.en: Which dictionary do you want?
dialogue.ur: Aap ko kaunsi lughat chahiye?

dialogue.en: I want the Arabic dictionary.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe Arabi lughat chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلِ المُعْجَمَ العَرَبِيَّ. وَماذا تُريدُ أَيْضاً؟
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍali l-muʿjama l-ʿarabiyya. wa mādhā turīdu ayḍan?
dialogue.en: Here is the Arabic dictionary. What else do you want?
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye Arabi lughat. Aur kya chahiye?

dialogue.tr: urīdu kitāba l-qirāʾa, wa kitāba l-qawāʿid
dialogue.en: I want the reading book and the grammar book.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe parhne ki kitaab aur qawaid ki kitaab chahiye.

dialogue.ar: هذا كِتابُ القِراءَةِ، وَهذا كِتابُ القَواعِدِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā kitābu l-qirāʾa, wa hādhā kitābu l-qawāʿid
dialogue.en: This is the reading book, and this is the grammar book.
dialogue.ur: Ye parhne ki kitaab hai aur ye qawaid ki kitaab hai.

dialogue.en: I want a notebook and a pen.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe ek copy aur ek qalam chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلِ الدَّفْتَرَ وَالقَلَمَ. هَلْ تُريدُ شَيْئاً آخَرَ؟
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍali d-daftara wal-qalam. hal turīdu shayʾan ākhar?
dialogue.en: Here are the notebook and the pen. Do you want anything else?
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye copy aur qalam. Kya aur kuch chahiye?

dialogue.en: No, thank you.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, shukriya.

dialogue.en: The amount due is thirty riyals.
dialogue.ur: Tees riyal bante hain.

dialogue.en: What are you saying? Thirty riyals?!
dialogue.ur: Aap kya keh rahe hain? Tees riyal?!

dialogue.en: Yes, thirty riyals.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, tees riyal.

dialogue.en: Here you are, these are thirty riyals.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye, ye tees riyal hain.

q.en: What does the student say first to ask for a dictionary?
q.ur: Talib-e-ilm lughat maangne ke liye kya kehta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ الطّالِبُ أَوَّلاً لِيَطْلُبَ مُعْجَماً؟

q.en: What does تَفَضَّلْ mean?
q.ur: تَفَضَّلْ ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: How much did the student have to pay?
q.ur: Talib-e-ilm ko kitne riyal dene pade?

q.en: What is قَلَم?
q.ur: قَلَم kya hai?

q.en: Which book does the student NOT buy?
q.ur: Talib-e-ilm kaunsi kitaab nahin khareedta?

intro.en: A woman buys fish, meat, chicken, vegetables and tea at the market. Notice that the seller says تُريدينَ (turīdīna) to a woman, but تُريدُ (turīdu) to a man.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek khatoon bazaar se machhli, gosht, murghi, sabziyan aur chai khareedti hai. Dhyan dein: aurat se kaha jata hai تُريدينَ (turīdīna) aur mard se تُريدُ (turīdu).
intro.ar: تَشْتَري امْرَأَةٌ السَّمَكَ وَاللَّحْمَ وَالدَّجاجَ وَالخُضارَ وَالشّايَ مِنَ السّوق. نُلاحِظُ أَنَّ البائِعَ يَقولُ لَها «تُريدينَ» وَيَقولُ لِلرَّجُلِ «تُريدُ».

dialogue.en: Hello, how can I help?
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed, kya khidmat karoon?

dialogue.tr: urīdu samakan wa laḥman wa dajājan
dialogue.en: I want fish, meat and chicken.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe machhli, gosht aur murghi chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلي السَّمَكَ وَاللَّحْمَ وَالدَّجاجَ. وَماذا تُريدينَ أَيْضاً؟
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍalī s-samaka wal-laḥma wad-dajāj. wa mādhā turīdīna ayḍan?
dialogue.en: Here are the fish, meat and chicken. What else do you want?
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye machhli, gosht aur murghi. Aur kya chahiye?

dialogue.tr: urīdu khiyāran wa baṣalan wa ṭamāṭim
dialogue.en: I want cucumbers, onions and tomatoes.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe kheera, pyaaz aur tamatar chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلي الخِيارَ وَالبَصَلَ وَالطَّماطِمَ. وَماذا تُريدينَ أَيْضاً؟
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍalī l-khiyāra wal-baṣala waṭ-ṭamāṭim. wa mādhā turīdīna ayḍan?
dialogue.en: Here are the cucumbers, onions and tomatoes. What else do you want?
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye kheera, pyaaz aur tamatar. Aur kya chahiye?

dialogue.tr: urīdu sukkaran wa shāyan wa bunnan
dialogue.en: I want sugar, tea and coffee.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe cheeni, chai aur coffee chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلي السُّكَّرَ وَالشّايَ وَالبُنَّ. هَلْ تُريدينَ شَيْئاً آخَرَ؟
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍalī s-sukkara wash-shāya wal-bunn. hal turīdīna shayʾan ākhar?
dialogue.en: Here are the sugar, tea and coffee. Do you want anything else?
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye cheeni, chai aur coffee. Kya aur kuch chahiye?

dialogue.tr: naʿam, ṭabaqa bayḍ, wa ʿulbata milḥ
dialogue.en: Yes, a tray of eggs and a box of salt.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, anday ki ek tray aur namak ka ek dabba.

dialogue.ar: هذا طَبَقُ البَيْضِ، وَهذِهِ عُلْبَةُ المِلْحِ. المَطْلوبُ ثَمانونَ دِيناراً.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ṭabaqu l-bayḍ, wa hādhihi ʿulbatu l-milḥ. al-maṭlūbu thamānūna dīnāran
dialogue.en: This is the tray of eggs and this is the box of salt. The amount due is eighty dinars.
dialogue.ur: Ye anday ki tray hai aur ye namak ka dabba hai. Assi dinar bante hain.

dialogue.en: Here you are, these are eighty dinars.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye, ye assi dinar hain.

q.en: What does the woman want first?
q.ur: Aurat sab se pehle kya chahti hai?

q.en: What is سُكَّر?
q.ur: سُكَّر kya hai?

q.en: How much does the woman pay in total?
q.ur: Aurat kul kitne dinar deti hai?

q.en: What does the seller say to ask a woman 'What else do you want?'
q.ur: Dukaan-daar aurat se 'aur kya chahiye?' kaise poochta hai?
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ الذي يُوَجِّهُهُ البائِعُ إِلى امْرَأَةٍ عَنْ طَلَبٍ آخَر.

q.en: Which of these is a vegetable?
q.ur: In mein se kaun si sabzi hai?

intro.en: A customer buys a shirt and a long thobe. Learn how to ask the price with بِكَمْ (bikam – how much?) and the colours white, yellow, blue, red and black.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek gaahak qameez aur lamba thobe khareedta hai. Hum qeemat poochna seekhenge بِكَمْ (bikam – kitne ka?) aur rang: safed, peela, neela, laal aur kaala.
intro.ar: يَشْتَري زَبونٌ قَميصاً وَثَوْباً طَويلاً. نَتَعَلَّمُ السُّؤالَ عَنِ السِّعْرِ بِـ«بِكَمْ» وَأَلْوانَ الأَبْيَض وَالأَصْفَر وَالأَزْرَق وَالأَحْمَر وَالأَسْوَد.

dialogue.en: Please, how can I help?
dialogue.ur: Tashreef laiye, kya khidmat karoon?

dialogue.en: I want a shirt, please.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe ek qameez chahiye, meherbani karke.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلْ هُنا، هذا قِسْمُ القُمْصانِ. هذا قَميصٌ أَبْيَضُ، وَهذا أَصْفَرُ، وَهذا أَزْرَقُ، وَهذا أَحْمَرُ، وَهذا أَسْوَدُ.
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍal hunā, hādhā qismu l-qumṣān. hādhā qamīṣun abyaḍ, wa hādhā aṣfar, wa hādhā azraq, wa hādhā aḥmar, wa hādhā aswad
dialogue.en: Come here, this is the shirts section. This shirt is white, this is yellow, this is blue, this is red and this is black.
dialogue.ur: Idhar aaiye, ye qamison ka hissa hai. Ye qameez safed hai, ye peeli, ye neeli, ye laal aur ye kaali hai.

dialogue.en: How much is the shirt?
dialogue.ur: Qameez kitne ki hai?

dialogue.ar: القَميصُ بِعِشْرينَ دينارًا. أَيَّ قَميصٍ تُريدُ؟
dialogue.tr: al-qamīṣu bi-ʿishrīna dīnāran. ayya qamīṣin turīd?
dialogue.en: The shirt is twenty dinars. Which shirt do you want?
dialogue.ur: Qameez bees dinar ki hai. Aap ko kaunsi qameez chahiye?

dialogue.en: I will buy the blue shirt.
dialogue.ur: Main neeli qameez khareedoon ga.

dialogue.en: This is the blue shirt.
dialogue.ur: Ye hai neeli qameez.

dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya.

dialogue.en: We have beautiful thobes.
dialogue.ur: Hamare paas khoobsurat thobe hain.

dialogue.en: How much is the thobe?
dialogue.ur: Thobe kitne ka hai?

dialogue.en: The thobe is thirty dinars.
dialogue.ur: Thobe tees dinar ka hai.

dialogue.en: I want the white thobe.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe safed thobe chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلِ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ، المَطْلوبُ خَمْسونَ دِيناراً.
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍali th-thawba l-abyaḍ, al-maṭlūbu khamsūna dīnāran
dialogue.en: Here is the white thobe. The amount due is fifty dinars.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye safed thobe. Pachaas dinar bante hain.

dialogue.en: Here you are, these are fifty dinars.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye, ye pachaas dinar hain.

q.en: How do you ask 'How much is the shirt?'
q.ur: 'Qameez kitne ki hai?' kaise poochte hain?

q.en: Which colour shirt does the customer choose?
q.ur: Gaahak kis rang ki qameez chunta hai?

q.en: How much is the shirt?
q.ur: Qameez kitne dinar ki hai?

q.en: What does قِسْمُ القُمْصانِ mean?
q.ur: قِسْمُ القُمْصانِ ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: How much is the white thobe in total?
q.ur: Safed thobe ke kul kitne dinar hain?
q.ar: كَمْ سِعْرُ الثَّوْبِ الأَبْيَضِ في المَجْموع؟

intro.en: Practise the shopping words: find the odd word out, match word parts with pictures, and learn the six colours. Every colour here is for a masculine word like قَميص (shirt).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum khareedari ke alfaaz ki mashq karenge: alag lafz dhoondhna, lafzon ko tasveeron se milana aur chhe rang seekhna. Yahan rang مذکر (mard wale) alfaaz ke liye hain, jaise قَميص.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ على كَلِماتِ التَّسَوُّق: نَجِدُ الكَلِمَةَ الغَريبَة، وَنَصِلُ أَجْزاءَ الكَلِماتِ بِالصُّوَر، وَنَتَعَلَّمُ سِتَّةَ أَلْوان. كُلُّ لَوْنٍ هُنا لِكَلِمَةٍ مُذَكَّرَةٍ مِثْلِ قَميص.

q.en: What colour is أَخْضَر?
q.ur: أَخْضَر kaunsa rang hai?

q.en: What colour is أَحْمَر?
q.ur: أَحْمَر kaunsa rang hai?

q.en: Which word means 'yellow'?
q.ur: Kaunsa lafz 'peela' ka matlab rakhta hai?

q.en: Which word is the odd one out: كِتاب، دَفْتَر، قَلَم، دينار?
q.ur: Alag lafz kaunsa hai: كِتاب، دَفْتَر، قَلَم، دينار?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ لا تَنْتَمي: كِتاب، دَفْتَر، قَلَم، دينار؟

q.en: Which word is the odd one out: سَمَك، لَحْم، دَجاج، قَلَم?
q.ur: Alag lafz kaunsa hai: سَمَك، لَحْم، دَجاج، قَلَم?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ لا تَنْتَمي: سَمَك، لَحْم، دَجاج، قَلَم؟

intro.en: Learn the useful shopping sentences: تَفَضَّلْ، أُريدُ، بِكَمْ، هذا / هذِهِ، أَيَّ ... تُريدُ؟ Also the numbers 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60. Use هذا for masculine things and هذِهِ for feminine things.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum khareedari ke kaam ke jumle seekhenge: تَفَضَّلْ، أُريدُ، بِكَمْ، هذا / هذِهِ، أَيَّ ... تُريدُ؟ Saath hi 20, 30, 40, 50 aur 60 ke ginti ke alfaaz. Muzakkar cheez ke liye هذا aur muannas ke liye هذِهِ kehte hain.
intro.ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ جُمَلَ التَّسَوُّقِ المُفيدَة: تَفَضَّلْ، أُريدُ، بِكَمْ، هذا وَهذِهِ، أَيَّ ... تُريد؟ وَالأَعْدادَ ٢٠ وَ٣٠ وَ٤٠ وَ٥٠ وَ٦٠. نَقولُ «هذا» لِلْمُذَكَّرِ وَ«هذِهِ» لِلْمُؤَنَّث.

vocab.en: the amount due, what is needed

q.en: Which word do we use for a feminine thing, like عُلْبَة (box)?
q.ur: Muannas cheez, jaise عُلْبَة (dabba), ke liye kaunsa lafz aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُها لِشَيْءٍ مُؤَنَّثٍ مِثْلِ عُلْبَة؟

q.en: Which word do we use for a masculine thing, like كِتاب (book)?
q.ur: Muzakkar cheez, jaise كِتاب (kitaab), ke liye kaunsa lafz aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُها لِشَيْءٍ مُذَكَّرٍ مِثْلِ كِتاب؟

q.en: What does بِكَمْ ask about?
q.ur: بِكَمْ kis cheez ke baare mein poochta hai?

q.en: What does أَرْبَعونَ mean?
q.ur: أَرْبَعونَ ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: How do you say 'I want the Arabic dictionary'?
q.ur: 'Mujhe Arabi lughat chahiye' kaise kehte hain?

title.en: Sounds and listening: the letter ظ
title.ur: Aawazein aur sun kar samajhna: harf ظ

intro.en: Learn the heavy sound ظ (ẓā'), which is different from the soft ذ (dhāl). Listen and repeat words like ظُهْر (noon), ظُلْم (injustice) and نَظَر (he looked). Then listen to a short dialogue and answer questions.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum bhaari aawaz ظ (zaa) seekhenge, jo narm ذ (zaal) se mukhtalif hai. Sunein aur dohrayein: ظُهْر (dopahar), ظُلْم (zulm) aur نَظَر (us ne dekha). Phir chhota mukaalma sun kar sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ الحَرْفَ المُفَخَّمَ ظ، وَهُوَ يَخْتَلِفُ عَنِ الذّالِ الرَّقيقَة. نَسْمَعُ وَنُكَرِّرُ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلِ ظُهْر وَظُلْم وَنَظَر، ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى حِوارٍ قَصيرٍ وَنُجيبُ.

q.en: Which letter is the heavy sound in ظُهْر?
q.ur: ظُهْر mein bhaari aawaz kaunsa harf hai?

q.en: What does ظُهْر mean?
q.ur: ظُهْر ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: Which word contains the soft letter ذ, not ظ?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein narm ذ hai, ظ nahin?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها الذّالُ الرَّقيقَةُ لا الظّاء؟

q.en: Which pair is heavy ظ then soft ذ?
q.ur: Kaunsi jodi pehle bhaari ظ phir narm ذ hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ زَوْجٍ مِنَ الكَلِماتِ فيهِ الظّاءُ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ الذّال؟

intro.en: Practise speaking with a partner. Ask مَاذا تُريدُ؟ (what do you want?) and answer أُريدُ ... (I want ...). Ask أَيَّ قَميصٍ تُريدُ؟ (which shirt?) and reply with a colour.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum kisi saathi ke saath bolne ki mashq karenge. Poochein مَاذا تُريدُ؟ (aap kya chahte hain?) aur jawab dein أُريدُ ... (mujhe ... chahiye). Poochein أَيَّ قَميصٍ تُريدُ؟ (kaunsi qameez?) aur rang bata kar jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زَميل: نَسْأَلُ «ماذا تُريد؟» وَنُجيبُ «أُريدُ ...». نَسْأَلُ «أَيَّ قَميصٍ تُريد؟» وَنُجيبُ بِلَوْن.

dialogue.en: What do you want?
dialogue.ur: Aap kya chahte hain?

dialogue.en: I want the reading book.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe parhne ki kitaab chahiye.

dialogue.en: Do you want anything else?
dialogue.ur: Kya aur kuch chahiye?

dialogue.en: No, and thank you.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, aur shukriya.

q.en: How do you ask 'What do you want?'
q.ur: 'Aap kya chahte hain?' kaise poochte hain?

q.en: How do you politely say 'No, thank you'?
q.ur: Adab se 'Nahin, shukriya' kaise kehte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ نَرُدُّ بِأَدَبٍ لِنَقولَ إِنَّنا لا نُريدُ؟

q.en: What does أُريدُ ثَوْباً mean?
q.ur: أُريدُ ثَوْباً ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: What does فاكِهَة mean?
q.ur: فاكِهَة ka kya matlab hai?

title.en: Reading: the market and the family

intro.en: Read four short passages: Malik buying a thobe, Rashid buying a shirt, a family furnishing a new flat, and a family going shopping on Thursday. Then answer the questions about what each person wants and the prices.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein chaar chhote ibaaratein parhein: Malik thobe khareedta hai, Rashid qameez khareedta hai, ek khandaan naye flat ka saaman leta hai, aur ek khandaan jumeraat ko bazaar jaata hai. Phir har shakhs ki pasand aur qeematon ke sawal hal karein.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ أَرْبَعَ فِقَراتٍ قَصيرَة: مالِكٌ يَشْتَري ثَوْباً، وَراشِدٌ يَشْتَري قَميصاً، وَأُسْرَةٌ تَفْرُشُ شَقَّةً جَديدَة، وَأُسْرَةٌ تَذْهَبُ إِلى السّوقِ يَوْمَ الخَميس. ثُمَّ نُجيبُ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة.

q.en: Malik is in the market. In which section is he now?
q.ur: Malik bazaar mein hai. Woh abhi kis hisse mein hai?
q.ar: مالِكٌ في السّوق. في أَيِّ قِسْمٍ هُوَ الآن؟

q.en: In the passage, how much is the blue thobe?
q.ur: Ibarat ke mutabiq neela thobe kitne riyal ka hai?
q.ar: كَمْ سِعْرُ الثَّوْبِ الأَزْرَقِ في الفِقْرَة؟

q.en: Which colour does Rashid like?
q.ur: Rashid ko kaunsa rang pasand hai?

q.en: Where does the wife put the television?
q.ur: Biwi TV kahan rakhti hai?

q.en: On which day does the family go to the market?
q.ur: Khandaan kis din bazaar jaata hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ يَوْمٍ تَذْهَبُ الأُسْرَةُ إِلى السّوق؟

intro.en: Practise writing: join letters to make words, put scrambled letters in order, write the word under each picture, and learn singular and plural words such as طِفْل – أَطْفال and طَبَق – أَطْباق. At the end you learn the numbers 30 to 80 and the words for shop talk.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein likhne ki mashq hai: harf jodh kar lafz banana, bikhre huye harf tarteeb mein lagana, tasveer ke neeche lafz likhna, aur wahid-jama seekhna jaise طِفْل – أَطْفال aur طَبَق – أَطْباق. Aakhir mein 30 se 80 tak ginti aur dukaan ki baaton ke alfaaz hain.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ على الكِتابَة: نَصِلُ الحُروفَ لِنُكَوِّنَ كَلِمات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الحُروفَ المُبَعْثَرَة، وَنَكْتُبُ الكَلِمَةَ تَحْتَ كُلِّ صورَة، وَنَتَعَلَّمُ المُفْرَدَ وَالجَمْع مِثْلَ طِفْل – أَطْفال وَطَبَق – أَطْباق، ثُمَّ الأَعْدادَ مِنْ ٣٠ إِلى ٨٠.

q.en: What is the plural of طِفْل (child)?
q.ur: طِفْل (bachcha) ki jama kya hai?

q.en: What is the plural of قَميص (shirt)?
q.ur: قَميص (qameez) ki jama kya hai?

q.en: What is the plural of ثَوْب (thobe)?
q.ur: ثَوْب (thobe) ki jama kya hai?

q.en: What number is سِتّونَ?
q.ur: سِتّونَ kaunsa adad hai?

q.en: What is the plural of طَبَق (plate)?
q.ur: طَبَق (plate) ki jama kya hai?
